records.label: Connection Name / Stable Key / Description / Tags
records.notes: Required name and stable generated key; changing provider type after use creates a new Connection instead of reinterpreting existing secrets/settings. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4.

records.label: Type / Provider Adapter (Generic HTTP or Certified Provider)
records.notes: Adapter fixes allowed auth modes, fixed hosts, signature algorithms and OAuth endpoints; Generic HTTP stays bounded by Safe HTTP policy. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §4, §6.

records.label: Status (Enabled/Disabled, Connected/Needs Auth/Unhealthy) / Environment Tag
records.notes: Enabled/Disabled is stored; Connected/Needs Auth/Unhealthy is derived health; optional production/staging/test environment tag. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §3, §4, §21.

records.label: Connections List Columns / Filters / Row Actions
records.notes: Safe host/scope summaries, used-by count, credential expiry indicator; duplicate/export always without secrets. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §2, §3.

records.label: Base URL (HTTPS Required by Default)
records.notes: wp_http_validate_url()/WP_Http substrate parses the URL; WPE adds HTTPS-by-default, scheme/host/port validation and Safe HTTP destination policy. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5, §11.

records.label: Allowed Path Prefix / Dynamic Path, Query and Body Values
records.notes: Dynamic values only in path segments under a fixed base, query or body; component-aware encoding; traversal normalized against the prefix. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5, §16.

records.label: Default Method Restrictions / Non-Secret Headers / Query Params / Content Type
records.notes: Header rows name/value source/sensitive reference; Host, Content-Length, adapter-owned Authorization and proxy/internal headers are blocked. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5, §17.

records.label: Connect / Request Timeout and Response Max Bytes
records.notes: Maps to WP_Http timeout and limit_response_size arguments; global maximum caps from Settings apply. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5, §38.

records.label: Proxy Handling (Inherited from WordPress / Approved Adapter)
records.notes: WP_PROXY_* wp-config constants are the native substrate; no per-connection arbitrary proxy definition. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: Auth Type (None / API Key Header / Bearer / Basic / OAuth 2.x / HMAC Signing)
records.notes: API key in query string is discouraged with a leakage warning; every secret-bearing auth type stores Vault references only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §6.

records.label: AWS SigV4 / Provider-Specific Signing / Custom Certified Auth Adapter
records.notes: Deferred to separate adapter certification and security review; not a generic configurable signer. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §6.

records.label: Secret Field as Vault Reference (Masked / Present State Only)
records.notes: Secret values live in the shared Vault; Surface 23 stores references only; UI never reads the full secret back into the browser. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §6, §7.

records.label: Add / Replace / Clear / Rotate / Test-After-Replace / Last Changed / Vault Health
records.notes: Blank edit keeps existing unless explicit Clear; never preloaded; excluded from export, revision diff, logs and AI context; secret permission separate from Connection edit. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7.

records.label: OAuth Provider Profile (Authorize/Token URLs, PKCE, Scopes, Callback, Refresh, Revoke)
records.notes: Defined by the provider adapter, not free-form admin input; no provider password collected unless a reviewed protocol requires it. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8.

records.label: OAuth State / PKCE / Admin Callback Handling
records.notes: WordPress nonce + capability-checked admin callback is the substrate for state binding; PKCE (RFC 7636) required where the provider supports it. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8, §45.

records.label: Connect / Reauthorize / Refresh Status / Disconnect & Revoke
records.notes: Displays connected account safe label, scopes, token expiry, refresh availability and last refresh; disconnect revokes per RFC 7009 where supported. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §8.

records.label: Scope Change → Reauthorization Required
records.notes: Never silently assume an old token has new scopes; show affected modules; keep old connection until new auth succeeds when safe. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §9.

records.label: Provider-Specific Safe Connection Test
records.notes: Read-only by default; write test explicit and cleanup-capable; reports DNS/connect/TLS, auth, scope, provider status, latency; never exposes full headers/body. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10.

records.label: SSRF Destination Policy (Blocked Ranges / Schemes / DNS / IPv6 / Redirect Targets)
records.notes: wp_safe_remote_request()/http_request_host_is_external substrate is incomplete; WPE blocks loopback, link-local, metadata, RFC1918, reserved/multicast and non-approved schemes after DNS resolution; adapter allowlists for certified fixed hosts. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11.

records.label: DNS Rebinding Protection (Validate-to-Connect Address Pinning)
records.notes: No native equivalent; revalidate/pin the resolved address between validation and connect according to accepted HTTP client capability. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11, §45.

records.label: Private Network Exact CIDR/Host Allowlist (High-Risk)
records.notes: Later only: disabled by default, dedicated high-risk capability, exact allowlist, metadata ranges always blocked, no arbitrary redirect, re-auth, audited changes. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §12.

records.label: Redirect Policy (None / Same-Host / Allowlisted / Max Count)
records.notes: WP_Http redirection argument substrate; every hop revalidated through SSRF policy; Authorization/secret headers stripped on cross-host redirect unless adapter defines safe behavior. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: TLS Certificate and Hostname Verification Required
records.notes: WP_Http sslverify substrate stays on; TLS errors surfaced distinctly; custom CA bundle is a future reviewed option only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14.

records.label: Reusable Outbound Request Profile
records.notes: Connection, relative path, method, headers, query mapping, body schema, accepted statuses, response schema/size, timeout, retry profile, idempotency mapping, log redaction; consumers never copy credentials. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §15.

records.label: Request Body Mode (JSON Mapping / Form / Certified Multipart / Bounded Raw)
records.notes: No serialized PHP objects; body preview redacts secrets/PII per schema. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §18.

records.label: Response Handling (Ignore / JSON / Bounded Text / Certified Binary) & Extract Mappings
records.notes: Max bytes, response schema, success status allowlist and selected-field storage; unbounded external responses never stored in workflow logs. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §19.

records.label: Retry Profile (None / Fixed / Exponential / Retry-After Aware)
records.notes: Attempts, initial/max delay, retryable categories, jitter candidate; scheduling delegated to the canonical Job service (WP-Cron substrate). Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §20.

records.label: Idempotency Key Mapping for Retried Writes
records.notes: Non-idempotent POST requires idempotency support or retry is disabled by default; not a native WordPress HTTP feature. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §15, §20.

records.label: Health States and Cooldown Circuit
records.notes: healthy/degraded/auth_expired/rate_limited/unavailable/misconfigured/disabled; cooldown after N failures; never auto-disables permanently without explicit policy; recovery resets. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §21.

records.label: Outbound Delivery Log (Metadata-First, Redacted)
records.notes: Delivery ID, profile, caller, method + safe host/path, status, attempts, timing, bytes, error category, correlation ID; never Authorization, cookies or secrets. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §22.

records.label: Inbound Webhook Name / Key / Randomized Path / Status / Provider
records.notes: Draft/Enabled/Disabled; generated randomized readable path; endpoint obscurity is not authentication. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §23, §24.

records.label: Inbound Receiving Route (REST Route Substrate)
records.notes: register_rest_route() with explicit permission semantics is the substrate; the public REST contract stays with Surface 22; route registration is not authorized by this Bank. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §24, §26.

records.label: Inbound Signature / Auth Mode (HMAC / Provider / Asymmetric)
records.notes: Secret Vault reference, timestamp/signature headers, adapter-fixed algorithms, replay window; Basic/Bearer only if provider requires; secret URL token never sole auth. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §25.

records.label: Signature Verification Ordering (Raw Body First, Reject Before Parse)
records.notes: Limit → raw bytes → identify → timestamp/replay → constant-time verify (hash_equals) → reject → parse/schema → event ID → receipt → enqueue. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §26.

records.label: Replay Window and Receipt Idempotency
records.notes: Bounded receipt identity (provider event ID, endpoint, safe metadata hash, first received, state); duplicates acknowledged without re-running business mutation; retention covers provider retry windows. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §27.

records.label: Inbound Body Schema / Event Type, ID and Timestamp Paths / Unknown Events
records.notes: Max depth/bytes, required fields, types, array max items; unknown events ignore-acknowledged/store metadata/reject chosen to avoid retry storms. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §28.

records.label: Inbound Event Mapping to WPE Event / Workflow Trigger / Handler
records.notes: Source event → WPE event type, safe payload mappings, transformation allowlist, privacy classification; raw provider payload is not the canonical domain event; Workflow (S17) owns orchestration. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §29.

records.label: Inbound Acknowledgment Status / Body / Deadline
records.notes: Adapter-defined status and body; prompt acknowledgment with heavy work queued asynchronously. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §30.

records.label: Inbound Method / Body / Rate / Concurrency / Depth Limits
records.notes: Source IP allowlist advisory only where provider publishes reliable ranges; signature still required; binary only for certified protocols. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §31.

records.label: Receipt States and Receipt Log Retention
records.notes: HTTP acknowledgment and processing states stay separate; metadata receipts by default; raw body off or short bounded encrypted retention with PII erase rules. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §32, §33.

records.label: Credential and Signing Secret Rotation with Bounded Overlap
records.notes: Outbound rollback only during bounded overlap; inbound multiple active verification secret versions with created/retire timestamps only when adapter requires; no secret shown after save. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §34.

records.label: Usage / Dependency Graph and Disable/Delete Impact
records.notes: Workflows, forms, webhooks, backup destinations, notification channels, membership billing, REST endpoints, SDK extensions; disable keeps secrets/data; delete requires no hard dependencies; history follows retention. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §35, §36.

records.label: Secret-Free Export / Import with credential_required State
records.notes: Exports provider/type, non-secret settings, credential placeholder and required scopes; import stays degraded until an admin binds a new Vault credential; package movement owned by Surface 26. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §37.

records.label: Global Defaults and Safety Caps
records.notes: Timeouts, caps, redirect max, retry, log/raw receipt/replay retention, private network disabled, webhook body max, rate default, health cadence, redaction strictness; caps raised only with higher capability. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §38.

records.label: Capabilities and Abilities (AI Read/Explain/Test Only)
records.notes: Separate read/manage/credentials/OAuth/test/logs/sensitive receipts/inbound/rotate capabilities plus dedicated private-network capability; Workflow editors select Connections without seeing secrets; AI never retrieves or rotates credentials. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §39, §40.

records.label: Events and Error/Degraded Diagnostics
records.notes: Connected/disconnected/auth-expiring/unhealthy/recovered, deduped delivery and receipt events; DNS/SSRF/TLS/auth/scope/rate/provider/Vault/signature/adapter-missing states; Pro expiry never weakens deployed verification. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §41, §42.

records.label: Performance Budgets and Asset Loading
records.notes: No external calls on unrelated admin requests; async slow calls; paginated logs; async cleanup; admin assets only on connection screens; no frontend assets for the server-side HTTP engine. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §43, §44.

records.label: Site / Network Scope and Secret Isolation
records.notes: Site vs network option storage (update_network_option substrate); per-site secret isolation; network-shared connections only via explicit network policy. Readiness: docs/PRODUCT/CONNECTIONS-WEBHOOKS-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md native audit list. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §38, §39.

records.label: Scheduled Health Check Cadence
records.notes: WP-Cron/Job substrate only where the canonical Job service allows; deduped health failures; no checks on unrelated requests. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §21, §38, §43.

records.label: Plaintext Secrets in Options / Revisions / Logs / Exports / AI Context
records.notes: Rejected: Vault references only; secrets never stored in plain options or exported. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §7, §37.

records.label: Plain HTTP as an Ordinary Production Toggle
records.notes: Rejected: plaintext only under a high-risk environment policy, never a normal toggle. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §5.

records.label: “Ignore SSL Errors” / Disable TLS Verification Toggle
records.notes: Rejected: a connection test cannot disable verification as a shortcut. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §14.

records.label: Loopback / Private / Link-Local / Metadata Destinations Allowed by Default
records.notes: Rejected: blocked by default; private networks only via the deferred high-risk allowlist; metadata never. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §11, §12.

records.label: Arbitrary Redirect Chains / Cross-Host Authorization Forwarding
records.notes: Rejected: every hop revalidated, credentials stripped cross-host. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §13.

records.label: Dynamic / User-Supplied Destination Host by Default
records.notes: Rejected: fixed base host; dynamic values only in path/query/body. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §16.

records.label: Visible Static Authorization Header Secrets
records.notes: Rejected: auth adapter/Vault references only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §17.

records.label: Unbounded Response / Body / Log Storage
records.notes: Rejected: explicit byte caps and selected-field storage only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §19, §22, §33.

records.label: Retrying Non-Idempotent Writes Without Idempotency Support
records.notes: Rejected: retry disabled by default unless idempotency is supported. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §20.

records.label: Unsigned / Unverified Webhook Business Processing (URL Secret as Sole Auth)
records.notes: Rejected where the provider supports signatures; IP allowlists never replace signatures. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §24, §25, §31.

records.label: User-Selected Weak Signature Algorithm
records.notes: Rejected: algorithms fixed by the provider adapter. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §25.

records.label: JSON Parse/Reserialize Before Raw-Body Signature Verification
records.notes: Rejected: verify exact raw bytes first. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §26.

records.label: Provider Event Replay Re-Running Business Mutations
records.notes: Rejected: duplicates acknowledged and counted only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §27.

records.label: Indefinite Raw Webhook Body Retention by Default
records.notes: Rejected: off or short bounded encrypted retention only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §33.

records.label: Authorization Headers / Cookies / Tokens in Logs, Events or Test Output
records.notes: Rejected: metadata-first redacted logs; events carry safe metadata only. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §10, §22, §41.

records.label: AI Credential Retrieval / Rotation / Arbitrary Outbound or Private-Network Widening
records.notes: Rejected: AI limited to read/explain/test safe metadata. Evidence: docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md §40.

coverage.notes: All 65 Connections/Webhooks records are classified from docs/MODULES/WEBHOOKS-CONNECTIONS-EXHAUSTIVE-SPEC.md and docs/PRODUCT/CONNECTIONS-WEBHOOKS-BANK-ENTRY-READINESS-V1.md. Native WordPress HTTP/nonce/REST/cron primitives are transport substrate only; secrets are Vault references only; Safe HTTP (SSRF/redirect/TLS) and inbound raw-body signature verification are mandatory; DNS-rebinding pinning, idempotency, health circuit and rotation overlap are WPE-exceed; provider signing adapters and private-network allowlists are deferred; 16 unsafe patterns stay rejected.
